OCTA 2-11-2024
Effective February 11, 2024
The Bus Service Change Improvements provides a summary of the upcoming service improvements to OC Bus. This service change will provide minor routing and schedule changes.
Schedule Adjustments
35, 42, 43, 47, 55, 56, 71
For detailed route schedules call (714) 636-RIDE or visit February 11 Bus Book.
FEBRUARY 11 BUS BOOK
Routes Details
Route 42:
Weekdays: Extend the first EB short trip at 5:08 a.m. to Electric and Main
Route 47:
Weekdays: Extend the first SB short trip at 4:45 a.m. to FTC
Route 56:
Weekdays: Eliminate routing on Chapman, Springdale, Orangewood, Valley View. All weekday trips will start at Belgrave.

# OC Bus: OCTA Tracker
## About this app
_arrow\_forward_
Never miss a bus again. OC Bus gives you accurate, real-time arrival times for every bus across the OCTA service. Whether you’re commuting to work, heading to class, or exploring, you’ll always know exactly when the next bus is arriving.
Features:
• Live Bus Map: Follow buses as they approach your station in real time.
• Nearby Stops: Instantly find the closest bus stops around you.
• Favorites: Save your most-used stops for one-tap access.
• Interactive Map: Search the full stop/route map and explore every line and stop across the county.
• Accurate ETAs: Reliable predictions so you’ll always know when to head out.
• Clean User Experience: Simple, fast, and easy to use.
Stay on top of your commute with this bus tracking app for Orange County. Download OC Bus today and take the guesswork out of public transit.
